description: Water Supply Service Reservoirs (Local System Storage) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Layer containing water supply service reservoirs (location and extent). Service reservoirs are minor local storages. Information captured using as-constructed drawings and aerial imagery, and includes service reservoir name, category / type, asset identifier, as-constructed plan references plus other key attributes. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Its tags are infrastructure-assets, reservoirs, transfer-network, water-supply, water-supply-assets. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
